title: Text: Lynn Henning ↔ Anthony Fenech
snippet: Great thought. It's something she can enjoy later, although not soon, because she'll be nursing. But, I like it, Anthony. One good thought: We'll have enough to get her two or even three good bottles.
searchText: great thought. it's something she can enjoy later, although not soon, because she'll be nursing. but, i like it, anthony. one good thought: we'll have enough to get her two or even three good bottles. if there's no immediate rush, i can pick them up or order and have them delivered. am gone this week but could happily do it next week. thoughts? lynn henning
